newsitem.title: UK: BP shares drop after in-line 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: BP shares drop after in-line 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in British Petroleum Co Plc fell on Tuesday after the oil giant posted results for 1996 which were roughly as analysts had expected.

The stock was down 24p at 697 by 1145 GMT, after being down 5-1/2p shortly before the results were announced -- unsettled by recent weakness in crude oil prices and a decline in the company's ADRs in New York yesterday.
BP posted a 30 percent rise in 1996 replacement cost profit to 2.62 billion stg, compared with forecasts mostly in a range between 2.50 billion and 2.75 billion.

"The results were towards the bottom end of the range," said one market-maker, but others said they were in line with expectations and the decline reflected no more than profit-taking after the stock's recent strong gains.
"I think they will rally from here," said one.
BP also said it would take a charge of 341 million stg to cover costs of a previously-announced restructuring in its downstream operations under a joint venture with Mobil Corp .
Its full-year dividend of 19.5p per share, up 28 percent on 1995, compared with analyst forecasts between 19.25p and 19.8p.
